description.en: Original nominal20m landscape teaching patch with artistically emphasized vertical relief with a river trunk splitting into connected distributary channels and raised sediment lobes projecting beyond a coast into lower exposed bed. Original bird-foot architecture, not an enlarged estuary or random ditch layout. Only land/sediment exported, no water/lights, tide/flow simulation or precise mapped paleosite; empty eras remain unspecified.
description.zh: 原创名义20米landscape教学片：主河分为连通分流道，隆起沉积叶瓣伸出岸线进入较低露床。独立鸟足状构造，不放大旧河口或随机加沟。只导出土地沉积物，无水灯、潮汐水流模拟或精确古地点测图；空时代保持未指定。
